title: John Chapter 5 Quiz - Multi-Level
description: An enhanced quiz on John chapter 5 with Easy, Medium, Hard, and Theological levels. Each level has 15 carefully crafted questions. Choose your difficulty and dive in!

easy.title: John Chapter 5 Quiz - Easy Level
easy.description: Perfect for beginners! Test your basic knowledge of John Chapter 5.

questions.question: In John 5, which of the following appears FIRST in the chapter?
options: A man with an infirmity thirty and eight years
Jesus tells a man to rise, take up his bed, and walk
The Jews say it is not lawful to carry the bed on the sabbath
questions.correctAnswer: Jesus went up to Jerusalem
questions.explanation: John 5:1 states, 'After this there was a feast of the Jews; and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.' This is the earliest event mentioned in the chapter.

questions.question: Where was the pool called Bethesda located?
options: By the sheep market in Jerusalem
questions.correctAnswer: By the sheep market in Jerusalem
questions.explanation: John 5:2 says, 'Now there is at Jerusalem by the sheep market a pool, which is called in the Hebrew tongue Bethesda.'

questions.question: How many porches did the pool Bethesda have?
questions.correctAnswer: Five
questions.explanation: John 5:2 states the pool had 'five porches.'

questions.question: Who lay by the pool Bethesda waiting for the moving of the water?
options: A great multitude of impotent folk, of blind, halt, withered
questions.correctAnswer: A great multitude of impotent folk, of blind, halt, withered
questions.explanation: John 5:3 says, 'In these lay a great multitude of impotent folk, of blind, halt, withered, waiting for the moving of the water.'

questions.question: What caused the water of the pool to be troubled?
options: An angel went down at a certain season and troubled the water
A strong wind stirred the pool
The priests stirred it with a rod
A spring beneath the pool flowed suddenly
questions.correctAnswer: An angel went down at a certain season and troubled the water
questions.explanation: John 5:4 explains, 'For an angel went down at a certain season into the pool, and troubled the water.'

questions.question: How long had the man Jesus healed been infirm?
questions.correctAnswer: Thirty and eight years
questions.explanation: John 5:5 states, 'And a certain man was there, which had an infirmity thirty and eight years.'

questions.question: What question did Jesus ask the man with the infirmity?
options: How long hast thou been here?
Do you believe I can heal you?
questions.correctAnswer: Wilt thou be made whole?
questions.explanation: John 5:6 records Jesus asking, 'Wilt thou be made whole?'

questions.question: What reason did the impotent man give for not being able to get into the pool first?
options: I have no man to put me into the pool when the water is troubled
He was too weak to move
The priests would not let him
questions.correctAnswer: I have no man to put me into the pool when the water is troubled
questions.explanation: John 5:7 says the man answered, 'Sir, I have no man, when the water is troubled, to put me into the pool.'

questions.question: What did Jesus command the man to do?
options: Rise, take up thy bed, and walk
Wait for the angel to trouble the water
questions.correctAnswer: Rise, take up thy bed, and walk
questions.explanation: John 5:8 records Jesus saying, 'Rise, take up thy bed, and walk.'

questions.question: What happened immediately after Jesus' command?
options: The man was made whole, took up his bed, and walked
The priests came to heal him
questions.correctAnswer: The man was made whole, took up his bed, and walked
questions.explanation: John 5:9 states, 'And immediately the man was made whole, and took up his bed, and walked.'

questions.question: What day was it when the man was healed?
options: The first day of the week
questions.correctAnswer: The sabbath
questions.explanation: John 5:9 says, 'and on the same day was the sabbath.'

questions.question: True or False: The man who was healed did not know who Jesus was at first.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: John 5:13 states, 'And he that was healed wist not who it was: for Jesus had conveyed himself away.'

questions.question: True or False: Jesus later told the healed man to sin no more, lest a worse thing come unto him.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: John 5:14 records Jesus saying, 'Behold, thou art made whole: sin no more, lest a worse thing come unto thee.'

questions.question: True or False: The Jews praised Jesus for healing on the sabbath day.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: John 5:16 states, 'And therefore did the Jews persecute Jesus, and sought to slay him, because he had done these things on the sabbath day.' They did not praise Him.

questions.question: True or False: The chapter says that the man was healed by the priests at the pool.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: The text attributes the healing to Jesus and the troubling of the water by the angel, not the priests (John 5:4, 5:8).

medium.title: John Chapter 5 Quiz - Medium Level
medium.description: Ready for more? Apply biblical truths from John Chapter 5 to real-life situations.

questions.question: According to Jesus in John 5:19, why can the Son do nothing of himself?
options: Because he only does what he sees the Father doing
Because he is waiting for the Father's permission
Because he is subordinate to the apostles
questions.correctAnswer: Because he only does what he sees the Father doing
questions.explanation: John 5:19 clearly states that the Son can do nothing of himself, but what he sees the Father do.

questions.question: What does John 5:24 promise will happen if someone hears Jesus' word and believes on Him who sent Jesus (John 5:23)?
options: They shall have everlasting life and shall not come into condemnation
They will be given wealth and prosperity
They will be exempt from all judgment
questions.correctAnswer: They shall have everlasting life and shall not come into condemnation
questions.explanation: John 5:24 promises everlasting life and exemption from condemnation to those who hear Jesus' word and believe on Him that sent Jesus.

questions.question: What authority has the Father given to the Son according to John 5:27?
questions.correctAnswer: Authority to execute judgment
questions.explanation: John 5:27 states that the Father has given the Son authority to execute judgment because he is the Son of man.

questions.question: How do John 5:22 and John 5:23 connect regarding judgment and honor?
options: The Father has given all judgment to the Son, so all men should honor the Son as they honor the Father
The Father judges separately from the Son, so honor is only due to the Father
Judgment and honor are unrelated according to these verses
The Son judges only some men, so only some honor is due to him
questions.correctAnswer: The Father has given all judgment to the Son, so all men should honor the Son as they honor the Father
questions.explanation: John 5:22 explains the Father has committed all judgment to the Son, and John 5:23 commands that all men honor the Son as they honor the Father.

questions.question: What does Jesus say about doing His own will in John 5:30?
options: He seeks not His own will, but the will of the Father
He sometimes acts on His own will
He ignores the Father’s will to fulfill His own
He has no will of His own
questions.correctAnswer: He seeks not His own will, but the will of the Father
questions.explanation: John 5:30 states that Jesus does not seek His own will but the will of the Father who sent Him.

questions.question: According to John 5:21, how does the Son quicken whom He will?
options: Just as the Father raises the dead and gives them life
By speaking words of healing only
Through the power of the apostles
questions.correctAnswer: Just as the Father raises the dead and gives them life
questions.explanation: John 5:21 explains that the Son quickens whom He will in the same way the Father raises the dead and gives them life.

questions.question: What is the result for those who have done good according to John 5:29?
options: They come forth to the resurrection of life
They are judged by the angels
questions.correctAnswer: They come forth to the resurrection of life
questions.explanation: John 5:29 states that those who have done good will come forth to the resurrection of life.

questions.question: Why did the Jews seek more to kill Jesus as explained in John 5:18?
options: Because He broke the Sabbath and said God was His Father, making Himself equal with God
Because He healed on the Sabbath without permission
Because He claimed to be a prophet
Because He gathered crowds in the temple
questions.correctAnswer: Because He broke the Sabbath and said God was His Father, making Himself equal with God
questions.explanation: John 5:18 explains the Jews sought to kill Jesus because He broke the Sabbath and claimed God was His Father, making Himself equal with God.

questions.question: How does John 5:20 describe the relationship between the Father and the Son in terms of works?
options: The Father loves the Son and shows Him all things He does, including greater works
The Son works independently from the Father
The Father only shows the Son past works
The Son is unaware of the Father's works
questions.correctAnswer: The Father loves the Son and shows Him all things He does, including greater works
questions.explanation: John 5:20 states the Father loves the Son and shows Him all things He Himself does and will show greater works so people may marvel.

questions.question: According to John 5:25, what happens when the dead hear the voice of the Son of God?
options: They shall be resurrected to condemnation
questions.correctAnswer: They shall live
questions.explanation: John 5:25 promises that when the dead hear the voice of the Son of God, they shall live.

questions.question: What does John 5:26 reveal about the life the Son has?
options: The Son has life in Himself as the Father has life in Himself
The Son's life depends on the Father’s will only
The Son has no life until resurrection
questions.correctAnswer: The Son has life in Himself as the Father has life in Himself
questions.explanation: John 5:26 states that the Father has life in Himself and has given the Son to have life in Himself.

questions.question: What does Jesus say about His own testimony in John 5:31?
options: If He bears witness of Himself, His witness is not true
His testimony is the most reliable
He does not bear witness of Himself
His witness is confirmed by the apostles
questions.correctAnswer: If He bears witness of Himself, His witness is not true
questions.explanation: John 5:31 says that if Jesus bears witness of Himself, His testimony is not true.

questions.question: According to John 5:32, what guarantees the truth of the other witness about Jesus?
options: Jesus knows the witness which another bears of Him is true
questions.correctAnswer: Jesus knows the witness which another bears of Him is true
questions.explanation: John 5:32 states Jesus knows that the witness borne by another is true.

questions.question: True or False: Jesus claims in John 5:30 that He judges by His own authority and will.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: John 5:30 shows Jesus judges as He hears and does not seek His own will but the Father’s will.

questions.question: True or False: John 5:24 states that those who hear Jesus’ word and believe in the Father who sent Him have eternal life and will not be condemned.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: John 5:24 explicitly states this promise of eternal life and no condemnation for believers.

hard.title: John Chapter 5 Quiz - Hard Level
hard.description: Challenge yourself with deep analysis and cross-biblical connections from John Chapter 5.

questions.question: Who did Jesus say bore witness unto the truth?
questions.correctAnswer: John
questions.explanation: Jesus refers to John in John 5:33, stating, 'Ye sent unto John, and he bare witness unto the truth.'

questions.question: What did Jesus say he did not receive testimony from?
questions.correctAnswer: Men
questions.explanation: In John 5:34, Jesus states, 'But I receive not testimony from man.'

questions.question: How did Jesus describe John?
questions.correctAnswer: A burning and shining light
questions.explanation: Jesus describes John in John 5:35 as 'He was a burning and a shining light.'

questions.question: What does Jesus say bears witness of him?
questions.correctAnswer: The works of the Father
questions.explanation: In John 5:36, Jesus states that 'the works which the Father hath given me to finish...bear witness of me.'

questions.question: According to Jesus, what have the people neither heard nor seen?
questions.correctAnswer: The Father's voice or shape
questions.explanation: Jesus states in John 5:37, 'Ye have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his shape.'

questions.question: What did Jesus say about those who search the Scriptures?
questions.correctAnswer: They testify of him
questions.explanation: In John 5:39, Jesus says, 'Search the scriptures; for in them ye think ye have eternal life: and they are they which testify of me.'

questions.question: What does the Greek word 'martyria' in John 5:34 mean?
questions.correctAnswer: Testimony
questions.explanation: 'Martyria' is the Greek word for testimony, as used in John 5:34, emphasizing the act of bearing witness.

questions.question: Which literary device is used in John 5:39 when Jesus says the Scriptures testify of him?
questions.correctAnswer: Allusion
questions.explanation: Jesus' statement in John 5:39 serves as an allusion, connecting his identity to the prophecies and teachings found in the Scriptures.

questions.question: Which other Bible passage connects to the theme of witnessing to Christ in John 5:33?
questions.correctAnswer: Isaiah 40:3
questions.explanation: Isaiah 40:3 speaks of preparing the way for the Lord, akin to John's role in testifying to Christ, paralleling John 5:33.

questions.question: Which passage fulfills the idea of eternal life through belief in Jesus as mentioned in John 5:39?
questions.correctAnswer: John 3:16
questions.explanation: John 3:16 emphasizes that belief in Jesus leads to eternal life, echoing the theme in John 5:39.

questions.question: What precedes Jesus' statement in John 5:37 about the Father's witness?
questions.correctAnswer: His healing of a man
questions.explanation: John 5:36 mentions the works Jesus does, which includes healing the impotent man, leading into the Father's witness in John 5:37.

questions.question: What comes immediately after Jesus’ claim that he does not receive honor from men in John 5:41?
options: He mentions the love of God
questions.correctAnswer: He mentions the love of God
questions.explanation: Immediately following John 5:41, in John 5:42, Jesus mentions that the people do not have the love of God in them.

questions.question: The statement 'I have greater witness than that of John' in John 5:36 implies what about Jesus’ authority?
questions.correctAnswer: He is divine
questions.explanation: This statement in John 5:36 emphasizes that Jesus' authority comes from divine works given by the Father, indicating his divine nature.

questions.question: Is it true that Jesus said, 'For had ye believed Moses, ye would have believed me'?
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Jesus indeed states in John 5:46, 'For had ye believed Moses, ye would have believed me: for he wrote of me.'

questions.question: Is it false that the Scriptures testify of Jesus according to John 5:39?
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: It is false; Jesus clearly states in John 5:39 that the Scriptures testify of him, affirming their role in revealing him.

theological.title: John Chapter 5 Quiz - Theological Level
theological.description: Deep biblical theology from John Chapter 5 that unites all believers. Explore foundational truths about God, creation, and humanity.

questions.question: What doctrine does John 5:24 teach about salvation?
options: Belief in the Son leads to eternal life and passage from death to life
Salvation is attained through the works of the law
Only the righteous by birth receive eternal life
Faith without works is sufficient for salvation
questions.correctAnswer: Belief in the Son leads to eternal life and passage from death to life
questions.explanation: John 5:24 clearly states that he who hears Jesus' word and believes in the Father who sent Him has everlasting life and has passed from death to life.

questions.question: What doctrine about divine judgment is taught in John 5:22?
options: The Father has committed all judgment to the Son
Judgment is reserved only for angelic beings
Humans judge themselves by their own conscience
The Son judges only after consulting the Holy Spirit
questions.correctAnswer: The Father has committed all judgment to the Son
questions.explanation: John 5:22 explicitly states that the Father judges no man but has committed all judgment to the Son, indicating the Son's unique role in final judgment.

questions.question: What doctrine concerning Christ’s relationship to the Father is taught in John 5:19?
options: The Son can do nothing of Himself but only what He sees the Father do
The Son acts independently of the Father’s will
The Son is inferior and separate from the Father
The Son operates by His own authority without divine guidance
questions.correctAnswer: The Son can do nothing of Himself but only what He sees the Father do
questions.explanation: John 5:19 teaches the doctrine of the Son’s perfect dependence on and unity with the Father, doing only what He sees the Father doing.

questions.question: Which divine attribute does John 5:26 specifically demonstrate?
questions.correctAnswer: Self-existence
questions.explanation: John 5:26 states that the Father has life in Himself and has given the Son to have life in Himself, demonstrating the attribute of self-existence.

questions.question: Which divine attribute is demonstrated in John 5:17 when Jesus says, 'My Father worketh hitherto, and I work'?
questions.correctAnswer: Sovereignty
questions.explanation: John 5:17 shows the ongoing divine work of both Father and Son, emphasizing God's sovereignty over time and creation.

questions.question: How does John 5:39 connect to the broader biblical narrative concerning the Messiah?
options: The Scriptures testify of Jesus as the Messiah, fulfilling Old Testament prophecy
The Scriptures are insufficient and need to be replaced by Jesus’ words
The Scriptures only focus on the law and ignore Christ
The Messiah is unrelated to the Old Testament writings
questions.correctAnswer: The Scriptures testify of Jesus as the Messiah, fulfilling Old Testament prophecy
questions.explanation: John 5:39 instructs to search the Scriptures because they testify of Jesus, linking the Old Testament witness to the coming and person of Christ.

questions.question: What redemptive-historical theme is prepared by John 5:25, where the dead hear the voice of the Son of God and live?
options: The resurrection and eternal life through Christ’s power
The necessity of ritual cleansing for salvation
The abolishment of all resurrection hope
questions.correctAnswer: The resurrection and eternal life through Christ’s power
questions.explanation: John 5:25 anticipates the resurrection of the dead and the granting of life by the Son, a key theme in biblical eschatology and redemption.

questions.question: What combined doctrine do John 5:21 and John 5:26 teach about the Son’s divine authority?
options: The Son has the divine power to give life and is self-existent
The Son is a created being with delegated power
The Son depends on angels for life-giving power
The Son has limited authority and cannot raise the dead
questions.correctAnswer: The Son has the divine power to give life and is self-existent
questions.explanation: John 5:21 shows the Son quickens whom He will, and 5:26 states the Son has life in Himself, together affirming His divine authority and self-existence.

questions.question: What combined doctrine about judgment do John 5:22 and John 5:27 teach?
options: The Son has been given authority to execute all judgment as the Son of Man
The Father judges independently without the Son
Humans judge their own salvation without divine intervention
Judgment is delegated to angels rather than the Son
questions.correctAnswer: The Son has been given authority to execute all judgment as the Son of Man
questions.explanation: John 5:22 assigns all judgment to the Son, and 5:27 affirms His authority to execute judgment as the Son of Man, indicating a unified judgment role.

questions.question: What theological synthesis is taught by John 5:30 and John 5:19 about Jesus’ will and action?
options: Jesus acts in perfect harmony with the Father’s will and does nothing independently
Jesus acts independently of the Father’s will
Jesus is unsure about His actions and decisions
Jesus seeks His own will above the Father’s
questions.correctAnswer: Jesus acts in perfect harmony with the Father’s will and does nothing independently
questions.explanation: John 5:19 shows the Son does nothing of Himself but what He sees the Father do, and 5:30 states Jesus seeks not His own will but the Father’s, indicating perfect unity.

questions.question: Skeptics claim Jesus’ works on the Sabbath violate divine law. What does John 5:16-18 teach about this accusation?
options: Jesus’ works reveal His unique divine authority and equality with God, not lawlessness
Jesus openly rejected the Sabbath law and advocated lawlessness
Jesus’ works were accidental and not intentional on the Sabbath
The Jews’ accusation was justified because Jesus broke the law
questions.correctAnswer: Jesus’ works reveal His unique divine authority and equality with God, not lawlessness
questions.explanation: John 5:16-18 explains that the Jews persecuted Jesus because He claimed to do God’s work even on the Sabbath, asserting His equality with God rather than breaking the law.

questions.question: What doctrine about Christ’s witness is taught in John 5:36?
options: The works the Father gave Jesus to finish bear witness that the Father sent Him
Jesus relies solely on human testimony for validation
The works Jesus performs are insignificant for His witness
Jesus’ witness is independent of the Father’s approval
questions.correctAnswer: The works the Father gave Jesus to finish bear witness that the Father sent Him
questions.explanation: John 5:36 teaches that Jesus’ miraculous works, given by the Father to accomplish, serve as divine testimony to His mission.

questions.question: Which divine attribute is demonstrated in John 5:23 regarding the honor due to the Son and Father?
questions.correctAnswer: Equality
questions.explanation: John 5:23 states that all men should honor the Son even as they honor the Father, showing equality in honor and divine status.

questions.question: How does John 5:45-47 connect to the Old Testament and Christ’s identity?
options: Moses’ writings testify of Christ, so belief in Moses entails belief in Jesus
Moses’ writings contradict the claims of Jesus
Jesus rejects the authority of Moses’ writings
The Old Testament is unrelated to Jesus’ mission
questions.correctAnswer: Moses’ writings testify of Christ, so belief in Moses entails belief in Jesus
questions.explanation: John 5:45-47 shows Jesus arguing that Moses, whom the Jews trust, wrote about Him, so genuine belief in Moses would lead to belief in Jesus.

questions.question: What combined doctrine do John 5:43 and John 5:44 teach about human reception of Christ?
options: People reject Christ when He comes in the Father’s name because they seek human honor
People universally receive Christ regardless of His approach
Belief in Christ is unrelated to honor or human recognition
People receive Christ only when He comes in His own name
questions.correctAnswer: People reject Christ when He comes in the Father’s name because they seek human honor
questions.explanation: John 5:43-44 reveal that humans reject Jesus who comes in the Father's name, preferring to receive those who seek honor from people rather than from God.
